watch.summary: The creator reacts with hysterical laughter to viral footage of a cheerleading robot squad completely collapsing and glitching during a performance.

beats.what: Creator introduces footage of cheerleading robots.
The robots attempt a synchronized jump and immediately faceplant onto the floor.
Creator bursts out into uncontrollable laughter at the sudden mass failure.
Creator mocks the failing robot, saying it's not skilled in gymnastics.
Creator notices it was not just one robot failing, but multiple robots falling and continuing routines on their backs.
Creator holds his head in disbelief as one remaining robot keeps doing flips off sync.

watch.author: mixed
watch.key_line: Dude is not skilled in the art of freaking gymnastics.
watch.why: The sight of sophisticated robots suffering catastrophic physical failure is universally funny. The creator's genuine, wheezing laughter and observational commentary make the visual slapstick even more enjoyable.
